summary: Cred and Duck (DonAlt) discuss Bitcoin's position near all-time highs at the top of a monthly range (60k-71k). Duck sold his position and sees 70k as the critical weekly level - a close below would flip him bearish. The US election is the dominant near-term catalyst, with Trump expected to win; a Trump win would cause a short-term spike while a Harris win could cause a significant nuke to 52k or lower. Bitcoin dominance at 60% reflects money flowing into BTC but not altcoins. ETH is weak against BTC and needs a Bitcoin rally to benefit from eventual altcoin rotation. SOL is in a downtrend on the BTC pair. Meme coins like PEPE and WIF are struggling even as BTC rallied. The overall advice is patience - either wait for ATH breakout confirmation or a deep flush to buy.
